nodes.title: Foundation Phase
nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 1
nodes.description: Grade 1

nodes.title: English Home Language
nodes.description: English Home Language for Grade 1 — Foundation Phase CAPS. Skills: Listening and Speaking, Phonics, Reading (Shared/Group Guided/Independent), Writing, Handwriting

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 1 English HL Term 1 (45 days, Weeks 1-10)

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Classroom routines; personal experiences; songs and rhymes; picture discussion; answering comprehension questions; following instructions; oral vocabulary development

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Letter-sound relationships; blending sounds to form words (at, c-at, m-at); alphabet: 2 vowels and 6+ consonants; segmenting and blending CVC words; onset and rime

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: book handling, print concepts, directionality, sight vocabulary; Group Guided Reading: emergent literacy, phonics in context; Independent Reading: classroom reading corner, familiar texts

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Drawing and adding a caption; copies letters and words from board; shared writing: teacher models, learners contribute; label pictures; write own name

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Correct pencil grip; posture and book position; directionality (left to right, top to bottom); lower case letter formation aligned with phonics letters taught

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 1 English HL Term 2 (49 days, Weeks 1-10)

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Listens without interrupting; personal experiences; sequences pictures; participates in discussions; answers open and closed questions; tells news; uses new vocabulary

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Consonant and vowel substitution; 3-letter word families (hot/hop/hob); sound families; reading phonic words in texts; onset and rime; blending and segmenting

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: use cover and pictures to predict; cause and effect; higher-order questions; Group Guided: phonics/context clues/sight words; Independent: fluency, familiar texts, classroom reading corner

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Drawing with caption; personal experience writing; write one sentence; shared writing; build word bank; begin using personal dictionary

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Lower case letters correctly formed by size and position; writes words with correct spacing between letters; consistent letter formation

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 1 English HL Term 3 (49 days, Weeks 1-10)

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Follows instructions and announcements; shares personal experiences; identifies similarities and differences; increasing vocabulary; participates in group discussions

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Revise single letters; common consonant blends; consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th); structural analysis; blending and segmenting words with digraphs

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: cause and effect; higher-order questions; capital letters and full stops; Group Guided: structural analysis, self-monitoring, increasing fluency; Independent: partner reading, classroom reading corner

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Write sentences using sounds and sight words; use capital letters and full stops; write 2 sentences own news; shared writing; contribute ideas for class story; begin using nouns and pronouns

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Lower case letters; begin capital letters and numerals; correct spacing between words; consistent letter size and formation

metadata.capsReference: Handwriting: lower case, capital letters and numerals

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 1 English HL Term 4 (49 days, Weeks 1-10)

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Stories about feelings; word puzzles, riddles and jokes; telling story with beginning/middle/end; varying tone and volume; oral language games; expressive communication

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Revise single sounds and consonant digraphs; new consonant blends (fi-sh, mu-ch, wi-th); word building; plurals (-s and -es); spelling 10 words per week; formal phonics assessment

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: sequence of events; cause and effect; initial problem in story; higher-order questions; Group Guided: structural analysis, sight words, fluency, punctuation; Independent: correct errors, classroom reading corner

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Shared Writing: class/group story; write 3 sentences own news; use capital letters and full stops; use prepositions; organise ideas into simple graphic form

metadata.capsReference: Writing: shared writing, own news, prepositions

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Upper and lower case letters; copies sentences correctly; consistent size, formation and spacing; writes with increasing speed and control
